model_name: A2 E Fleet Operations Financial Model
source_workbook: A2 E FLEET OPERATIONS  FINANCIALS-VER 1 c.xlsx
purpose: Machine-readable replication reference for rebuilding the workbook so that base assumptions reproduce the Excel outputs exactly and assumption changes cascade through all dependent calculations.

sheet_roles.ASSUMPTIONS_DATA: Master driver sheet for truck additions, operating assumptions, pricing, energy cost, and total investment.
sheet_roles.CAPEX & DEPRECIATION: Maps assumption-driven capex into annual capex, depreciation schedules, and asset carrying values.
sheet_roles.SOURCE_USE OF FUNDS: Tracks annual equity subscription, cumulative equity, and use of funds linked to capex and reserves.
sheet_roles.REVENUE PROJECTION: Pass-through layer from assumptions for tonnes, rate per tonne, and freight revenue.
sheet_roles.INCOME STATEMENT: P&L including revenue, battery energy cost, fixed opex growth, variable opex, EBITDA, depreciation, tax, net income, investor returns, and IRR.
sheet_roles.CASH FLOW: Operating, investing, and financing cash flows with dividends and closing cash.
sheet_roles.BALANCE SHEET: Cash, PP&E, equity, and retained earnings plug.
sheet_roles.KEY METRICS: EBITDA margin, net margin, and ROE.
sheet_roles.VALUATION SUMMARY: Milestone-year EBITDA valuation, equity value, investor stake value, MOIC, and IRR reference.

replication_rules: Use the workbook as source of truth for formula text and sheet layout.
Initialize all hardcoded assumption cells to the workbook base values exactly.
Preserve blank cells where the workbook leaves them blank; do not infer missing values unless formulas do so.
Implement formulas exactly as written first, even when labels imply different economics.
Support recalculation when any assumption changes so that all dependent cells update recursively.
Model internal assumption cascades, especially cumulative fleet, freight rate growth path, reserve split, and derived operating metrics.
Validate each major output series against the base workbook values after loading base assumptions.
known_quirks_and_audit_flags: Sheet name `INCOME STATEMENT ` includes a trailing space and must be preserved exactly.
ASSUMPTIONS_DATA starts forecast years in columns D:N while most other sheets start years in C:N or other offsets.
The model uses direct cell links heavily; exact row/column positions matter.
INCOME STATEMENT!C8 uses `=C3*C7` while later years use `=Revenue*0.25`; replicate this literal formula, not the intended logic.
INCOME STATEMENT!N12 differs from the 30% tax pattern; replicate workbook behavior exactly before deciding whether to normalize it.
SOURCE_USE OF FUNDS row 5 is labeled `(25%)` but actually references total investment directly, not 25% of it. Replicate literal formulas first.
BALANCE SHEET retained earnings is a plug: Total Assets - Equity.
ASSUMPTIONS_DATA row 35 contains an unlabeled formula `=C32/750`; keep only if you need complete sheet parity.

internal_cascade_rules.name: fleet_additions_to_operating_fleet
internal_cascade_rules.logic: Annual truck additions accumulate into number of trucks in operation.

internal_cascade_rules.name: operating_fleet_to_energy_cost
internal_cascade_rules.logic: Fleet in operation drives fleet kilometers, then energy purchased, then total energy cost.
equations: Fleet KM = Avg KM per truck per year * Trucks in operation
Energy Purchased = Energy used per km * Fleet KM
Energy Cost = Cost per kW * Energy Purchased

internal_cascade_rules.name: fleet_to_tonnes_to_revenue
internal_cascade_rules.logic: Trips per truck and tonnes per trip drive chargeable tonnes; ETB freight rate converts to USD and multiplies against tonnes.
equations: Operating days = 365 - 52 - 10
Trips per truck per year = Operating days / Days per trip
Fleet trips = Trucks in operation * Trips per truck
Chargeable tonnes = Avg chargeable tonnes per trip * Fleet trips
USD freight rate = ETB freight rate / 155
Revenue = Chargeable tonnes * USD freight rate

internal_cascade_rules.name: truck_and_support_capex
internal_cascade_rules.logic: Truck unit cost, software, hardware, reserve, and contingency build annual total investment and capex.
equations: Total cost of trucks = Cost per truck * trucks added
Total investment = sum(trucks + software + hardware + reserve + contingency)
Equity injection line directly references total investment row
Capex schedule directly references truck/software/hardware rows

cross_sheet_cascade_rules.name: capex_to_depreciation_to_ppande
cross_sheet_cascade_rules.logic: Capex additions are depreciated by asset class life and roll forward into asset values and income statement depreciation.
equations: Truck depreciation schedule uses 15-year life
Software uses 8-year life
Hardware uses 10-year life
Total depreciation = truck schedule total + software schedule + hardware schedule
Asset value = prior asset value - current year depreciation bucket + current capex additions

cross_sheet_cascade_rules.name: income_statement_to_cash_and_valuation
cross_sheet_cascade_rules.logic: Revenue and costs create EBITDA, EBT, tax, and net income; net income flows to cash flow and investor return metrics.
equations: Gross margin = Revenue - Cost of battery charge
Variable opex = 25% of revenue (except C8 appears =C3*C7 and should be replicated as-is)
EBITDA = Gross margin - fixed opex - variable opex
EBT = EBITDA - depreciation
Tax generally = 30% of EBT; N12 has a different formula and should be replicated as-is
Net income = EBT - tax
Closing cash = opening cash + net change in cash
Balance sheet cash = cash flow closing cash
Investor stake value = equity value * 25%
MOIC uses investor stake value divided by cumulative equity at selected checkpoints
